# Phool with Love

> Handcrafted pipe-cleaner and plush fabric flower bouquets, gift hampers, and
> custom floral arrangements — designed to last for years instead of wilting
> like fresh flowers. Handmade in HSR Layout, Bengaluru, India. Ships pan-India.

## About

Every bouquet is hand-shaped from premium pipe cleaners and plush fabric, stem
by stem, in a small home studio — no two are ever quite identical. Suited to
birthdays, weddings, anniversaries, graduations, or any everyday gift.

## How ordering works

1. Pick a ready-made bouquet, or start a custom order (colours, occasion, budget).
2. Hand-crafted to order, usually within 2-5 business days.
3. Packed for shipping — no water or refrigeration needed.
4. Shipped pan-India; delivery timelines vary by location.

Checkout happens via WhatsApp: add items to the cart on the site, then tap
"Order via WhatsApp" to confirm with the team.

## Policies

- Ships across India, 2-5 day processing before shipping.
- Handmade items are non-returnable unless damaged; report damage within 24
  hours of delivery.
- Advance payment may apply to custom orders.
- Colours may vary slightly by screen.
